summary:
Previously
  identified defects are resolved in the supplied paths. Whole-file integrity is now enforced before
   substring checks via reviewed lockfile hashes, malformed or unterminated frontmatter is rejected,
   installed extension registration now requires an actual array entry match, MCP/GSD config roots
  reject null/arrays, equivalent MCP server objects no longer fail on key order alone, and tracker
  config parsing/validation now correctly rejects malformed JSON and invalid root shapes without
  treating them as absent.
reviewer: Independent read-only GitHub Copilot CLI context, gpt-5.4
scope: New Azure profile installer, Spec Kit wiring/integrity and tracker guards, and integration metadata; not a formal security audit.
